Assessment done. 

Arrived on site to diagnose a malfunctioning bottle filling station/water bubbler. Upon inspection, the bottle filler was found continuously discharging water at full flow after the motion sensor was activated. The solenoid valve failed to close even after the pump and electrical terminals were disconnected, indicating the valve was mechanically stuck open rather than being held open by an electrical signal.
 
Further inspection identified the failed component as the bottle fill solenoid valve assembly located beneath the bottle filler. Due to the valve remaining open without power, replacement of the solenoid valve assembly is recommended. Technician is currently working with the manufacturer to identify the correct replacement part and confirm availability, as the required repair parts are not currently stocked. Awaiting manufacturer technical support and parts verification before completing the repair.
